quests.title: Town Hall: Lamps, As A Line In The Budget
quests.description: Two lantern draughts a month for the square, and the note makes a point of the wording: this is not a favour and it is not an emergency. It is an order placed by a town with a charter, against a budget line, with a price agreed in advance. Elric has wanted to write that sentence for four years.

quests.title: Infirmary: On The List, Not On The Door
quests.description: Three healing draughts a season, from the infirmary's own restock list rather than from Wren coming up the hill to ask. She notes that the list has had a blank line at the bottom of it for twenty years and that filling it in took her about nine seconds once there was somebody to fill it in with.

quests.title: Survey: Somebody Else's Rounds Now
quests.description: Four truemeasure tonics, sealed, for a keeper who is not Lyra. The survey has taken on a second pair of hands and the whole point of a dose that does not drift is that it works the same in somebody else's. Lyra writes that she is finding this harder to hand over than she expected to, and that this is her problem rather than the valley's.

quests.title: Beds: Four Years In A Cold Room
quests.description: Six seedhold solutions for the bed rows, and Rowan is blunt that this is not an order for this year. It is the beginning of a seed store: four autumns of stock held cold, so that the valley never again finds out what it costs to lose one. She has wanted to write this order since she was nineteen and has never once had the seed to spare for it.

quests.title: Archive: What Was Kept Instead Of Thrown
quests.description: Two second-draft tonics for the reading room, and Ione is placing the order for the shelf rather than for the room. She spent nine years on a record with eleven months cut out of it by somebody who did not want their working found. She would like a bottle on that shelf that could only exist because this tower now keeps the pages it got wrong.
